usage_note: Share of the top 100 Gauntlet (PvP) squads using the savior, snapshot 12 Nov 2026
inv_note: Investment counts key upgrades in the skill data: cooldown cuts and passive unlocks. Low 0-2, Medium 3-4, High 5+.

voyager-stranis.why: The hero-with-a-sealed-sword energy is great, the damage is just average now.

voyager-smile.why: Cute cannon, real burn damage, but she hits one target at a time and it shows.

voyager-oracle.why: Cleans up groups and makes everything squishier. Great in PvP, decent in PvE.

maid-lantern.why: A crow-throwing Chaos caster who hits the whole room, delays enemies and refuses to die once.

maid-bell.why: The fastest debuffer around. Silence and buff-strip make bosses a lot less scary.

maid-twohander.why: A broom-wielding tank who gives your carry Barrier and ATK Up without losing her own turn.

kingdom-knight.why: Honest knight, honest buffs. Good support-striker, not a headliner.

kingdom-shielder.why: A sturdy shield and not much else. Emily does the same job better.

kingdom-pray.why: A real healer with a real cleanse. Great with Star allies, average everywhere else.

nightmare-reaper.why: Buffs your best attacker, slows the boss and then goes in for the kill. Excellent in PvP.

stellar-thief.why: Fast, flashy and fragile. She's fun and the numbers just aren't there yet.

eastern-swordmaster.why: A Star carry that powers the whole Star team. Wuxia energy, big numbers, a learning curve.

incognita-landgrave.why: A Sun gunslinger who burns the whole enemy team once your allies have charged her up. Every skill is named after a grudge.

incognita-flower.why: A tank that guards herself first and her team second. Solid, not exciting.

eastern-owl.why: A friendly healer who ruins an enemy's day. Fine in PvE, really poor in PvP.

apostle-gille.why: The orchestra conductor of break teams. Great if you have Shatter partners, weak if you don't.

magician-druid.why: A Star caster who powers up when her team attacks. Strong, but she needs the squad.

saintess-demon.why: Burn, ATK Down and a bonus for every debuff. Muriel loves a messy enemy.

saintess-elf.why: The only healer who can bring someone back from the dead. Slow but dependable.

apostle-tyria.why: A Defender-killer with Shatter and DEF penetration. Her passive is called Guillotine Executor. Subtle.

recon-knuckle.why: A Star brawler who punches back when someone nukes your team. Simple and strong.

recon-amulet.why: A puzzle character with a big payoff. Lugh rewards players who like to read the tooltip.

independent-vagabond.why: A dodgy assassin whose defense plan is a 50% coin flip. It works better than it sounds.

grace-dualsword.why: A tidy duelist with a big hit and a weak team role. Not many reasons to pick her.

starpiercer-omega.why: A laser-happy caster who feeds on Star allies. Fun to watch, not easy to fit.

bunny-knight.why: A gambler carry whose Special buffs the whole team and ends with an extra turn. The table-flip ult is a bonus.

west-beamsword.why: A debuffer who Freezes, Stuns and drags turn gauges for the whole enemy team. Crowd control with a sword.

west-rod.why: Stacks Hex on the whole field and snowballs. Good in a team of debuffers.

detective-professor.why: Her bag forces free Dual Attacks with your carry, and her ult makes the enemy take 20% more Special damage. Weirdly strong.

detective-sheriff.why: A whip-wielding detective who turns every ally attack into free hits of her own.

wild-hog.why: Speed-scaling bruiser who protects the team and slows the enemy. Cheap and good in Sun.

construct-bomb.why: A bomb-throwing carry who gets faster every time a teammate breaks something.

bunny-scissors.why: A pinball-themed debuffer who speeds up as the fight goes on. Fun, if a bit random.

bunny-spear.why: Crit, dash, crit again. A clean, strong Moon carry.

summer-oracle.why: A swimsuit tank who punishes crit hits with DEF Down, Taunt and a Barrier. Top PvP pick by a mile.

summer-smile.why: A star-powered assassin who marks the fastest enemy and lets her team do the rest.

independent-dragon.why: The fastest unit in the game, with an ult that weakens every enemy and a passive that rewards getting hit.

construct-gadget.why: The break specialist. She buffs the party's crit and speeds everyone up when she breaks.

detective-watson.why: A caster who hands out Barriers and hits hard once she's ready. Interesting, but few teams want her.

mutant-mask.why: Sneaks, silences and punishes silenced targets. Kyra needs a plan, but it's a good one.

dress-stranis.why: A healer who heals everyone with her Special and still hits for damage. Rude to the other healers.

wedding-shielder.why: She eats 40% of the damage meant for your carry, heals the whole team off a basic attack and wipes debuffs. Yeah, she's that good.

wedding-dualsword.why: A shield-breaker caster. Great against Barriers, forgettable against everything else.

bunny-pray.why: Gives the party crit, then goes all in. Moon's cleverest buffer-caster.

stranisearl-roseblade.why: A graceful assassin who hits like a truck and cleans her own debuffs. Easily one of the best carries.

halloween-beamsword.why: A maid who heals the whole team, cleanses and buffs ATK, then gets a free extra heal every few turns. The healer to beat.

halloween-rod.why: A caster who rides your carry's coattails. Strong in PvP, a little fiddly in PvE.

dark-unknown.why: Breaks bosses by herself and then hits them again for free. Pick her for break teams.

west-lancer.why: A free-to-play shield for the first few chapters. Nothing more.

officer-police.why: A guard who heals herself with donuts. Useful until you get a real tank.

construct-wrench.why: A tough little crit-and-burn assassin. Starter material.

lpu-post.why: A basic healer for your first dungeons. Sweet and underpowered.

noa-observer.why: A debuffing ranger with a ruler and a sextant. Useful early, forgettable later.

maid-spear.why: A quick maid with a spear who gains turn progress. A budget Moon hitter.

maid-scissors.why: Burns things and likes it. A cheap, cheerful Sun striker.

magician-sniper.why: Slows enemies and snipes. Clarissa is a good early crit ranger.

counterside-hilde.why: The Fenrir Squad's tank: shields the team at the start and then tanks with Immunity. Reliable.

counterside-mina.why: A rookie with a revolver and a big ultimate. Bleed damage and a growing ATK stack.

counterside-rosaria.why: A planet-cleaving nuke with a "no, you can't kill me" passive. One of the strongest carries in the game.
